text:
Mira: FYI link-scan just flagged the architecture diagram on /runtime/overview as 403 — image is at https://old-cdn.redwood-assets.com/arch_v2.png. Can someone own a quick fix?
link-scan-bot: Scan result: path=docs/runtime/overview.html image=https://old-cdn.redwood-assets.com/arch_v2.png status=403 rule=external-cdn-fail
Sam: I can take this. Is there a canonical copy we can rehost?
Mira: There is a copy in s3://redwood-docs-assets/arch_v2.png but lifecycle rules mean it's not the canonical public URL. Two options: rehost to our CDN + update the doc, or inline a small SVG fallback. For a fast patch, rehost + update path. Quick sed I would run locally: `git grep -l "old-cdn.redwood-assets.com" docs | xargs sed -i 's|old-cdn.redwood-assets.com|cdn.redwood.com|g'` — but please be selective, check other uses first.
Sam: OK I'll open a small PR to rehost and update references. Thinking also to add an `onerror` fallback to the img tag pointing to `/static/arch_v2.svg` so pages don't break if CDN flaps. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12888 (WIP)
Jack: Quick note — when we switch CDN host we'll need cache invalidation. Either append a cache-bust query `?v=20260318` or use the asset hash. Please ping infra for invalidation window so we don't have stale 404s.
Mira: Good call. @Sam please add label `doc-owner:runtime` to the PR and ping @infra for CDN invalidation after merge. Also can we add a small unit for the link-scan CI: prefer S3 source if present as a fallback.
link-scan-bot: Ack. Will re-run scan after PR merged and notify this thread. Next scheduled run ~6h.
Sam: PR opened, added owner label, included the inline fallback and cache-bust param. I left a small test in tests/link_checks.py to prefer S3 fallback. Waiting on infra for invalidation timeframe.
Jack: Nice, thanks Sam. Once infra confirms we can merge and let the bot re-run. :thumbsup:
Mira: Thanks everyone — marking this actionable. If infra gives a >2h invalidation window please hold merge until it's done.
link-scan-bot: Notified infra team. Will post results when invalidation complete.
